column1: # Game profile of Cytus α (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.0.6 = v393216). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Unity 2018.2.18f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 6.4.2; subsdk0 is the movie module. Its sdk and subsdk0 are AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES' builds (010089B00D09C000), so no rewriter cut or host change was needed.
# A touch game: it reads the touch screen in handheld mode only, so the profile starts handheld (Normal, 1280x720) with the Tap layout.
# It presents at interval 1 (60 fps). The profile started as the provisional one of scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py; every guessed key was kept as the boot measured it
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region (it asks for 3.14 GB, which fits with the default 64 MB of used memory)
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# Cytus α takes the touchscreen only in handheld mode (docked, a click on the Mac and a touch on the iPhone do nothing), so it starts handheld with the Tap layout.
# It stays in handheld Normal (1280x720) rather than perf_mode boost: both its custom touch plugin (main+0xc4bb90) and Unity's SwitchInput (main+0x1000270) take raw 1280x720
# panel coordinates without scaling (and Unity's Input.GetTouch hardcodes 720 - y)
